```{r}
# Packages
library(dataRetrieval) 
library(dplyr)         
library(tsibble)          
library(timetk)         
library(modeltime)       
library(prophet)      
library(fable)        
library(fable.prophet)    
library(ggplot2)        
library(lubridate)
library(tidymodels)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)

# Exercise 21 code
poudre_flow <- readNWISdv(siteNumber = "06752260",    
                          parameterCd = "00060",      
                          startDate = "2013-01-01",   
                          endDate = "2023-12-31") %>% 
  renameNWISColumns() %>%                              
  mutate(Date = yearmonth(Date)) %>%                   
  group_by(Date) %>%                                   
  summarise(Flow = mean(Flow))

poudre_tsb <- poudre_flow %>% 
  as_tsibble(index = Date)

timeser_plot <- ggplot(poudre_tsb, aes(x = Date, y = Flow)) +
  geom_line(color = "purple") +
  labs(title = "Streamflow",
       y = "Flow", x = "Date") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(timeser_plot)

# Prophet model 
pmod <- list(
  prophet_reg() %>%
    set_engine("prophet"),
  arima_reg() %>% 
    set_engine("auto_arima")
)

poudre_tsb$Date <- as.Date(poudre_tsb$Date)
model <- map(pmod, ~ fit(.x, Flow ~ Date, data = poudre_tsb))

table_model <- as_modeltime_table(model)

# Forecast the next 12 months with modeltime
future_months <- poudre_tsb %>% 
  future_frame(Date, .length_out = "12 months")

forecast <- table_model %>%
  modeltime_forecast(
    new_data    = future_months,
    actual_data = poudre_tsb
  ) %>%
  filter(.key == "prediction") %>%
  select(.model_id, Date = .index, Predicted = .value)

# Streamflow data download and aggregate
streamfl <- readNWISdv(
    siteNumber  = "06752260",
    parameterCd = "00060",
    startDate   = "2024-01-01",
    endDate     = "2024-12-31"
  ) %>%
  renameNWISColumns() %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as_date(Date),
    Date = floor_date(Date, "month")
  ) %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  summarise(Observed = mean(Flow, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# R2
compare <- forecast %>%
  left_join(streamfl, by = "Date")

r2_value <- summary(lm(Observed ~ Predicted, data = compare))$r.squared
cat("R² = ", round(r2_value, 3),
    " → ", round(r2_value * 100, 1),
    "% of observed monthly variance explained by the forecasts.\n", sep = "")

# Plot
ggplot(compare, aes(x = Predicted, y = Observed, color = factor(.model_id))) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +                    
  labs(
    title    = "Predicted vs. Observed Values",
    x        = "Predicted (cfs)",
    y        = "Observed (cfs)",
    color    = "Model\nID"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
